infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SecureWay requires location access to send emergency SOS alerts with your precise coordinates.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: SecureWay continuously shares live location updates with your emergency contacts while using the app and in the background.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: SecureWay tracks your live location in the background to ensure your safety shield remains active even when the app is closed.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: SecureWay requires access to your phone contacts so you can easily select and add trusted emergency contacts.
